item.description: Jeremy Ngakia’s stunning second-half strike earned Watford a valuable three points in the Sky Bet Championship as they overcame fellow play-off contenders Bristol City at Ashton Gate. item.title: Heffernan’s first EFL goal earns Harrogate valuable point against Cheltenham
item.description: Cathal Heffernan scored his first EFL goal as Harrogate Town continued their fight for safety with a hard‑earned draw against in‑form Cheltenham at The EnviroVent Stadium. The 20‑year‑old defender rose highest to nod home early in the second half, cancelling out Isaac Hutchinson’s opener and extending the Sulphurites’ unbeaten run to five matches. item.title: Conor Coady champions inclusion as final EFL X PUMA Rainbow fixtures get underway
item.description: Charlton Athletic’s Conor Coady is recognised for more than his distinguished career on the pitch. As a prominent voice and active ally of the LGBTQ+ community, the central defender continues to use his platform to make a real-world difference in the hope that the game that has given him “everything in life” would offer the same sense of belonging to others.
